ITEM 1 | Single strip of cooked meat with alternating layers of reddish-brown and pale pinkish-white fat, showing crisp browned edges and some darker caramelized spots; slightly glossy with rendered fat sheen, curled and folded into an irregular S/loop shape about 18 cm long and 2-3 cm wide, sitting directly on the white square plate near its center | 15

ITEM 2 | Thin pale-yellow greasy residue smeared lightly across the white plate surface around the meat, faint and translucent with a slight sheen | 2
